# Packages with no tests, and why none:
# no-tests: e2e/connopt: the browser suite's connection options (plain, or SASL over TLS by the run's identity); exercised by every helper the suite starts, in both identities
# no-tests: e2e/errnames: prints kerr's error names for the Traffic boards spec, which compares them with the Result column; the spec is its test
# no-tests: e2e/hold: a consumer the browser suite keeps alive for live pages; the specs that start it fail if it does not print ready and stay in its group
# no-tests: e2e/identity: runs the browser suite against the second identity (e2e.yml, task test:e2e:identity); that run is its test
# no-tests: e2e/put: writes one record with a chosen timestamp for time.spec.ts, which asserts the shown time
# no-tests: e2e/routes: prints console/routes.go as JSON for the route gate, which fails on a route the table has and the suite did not reach
# no-tests: internal/kmsg: the vendored, generated Kafka message codec (franz-go's kmsg, PATCHES.md says what was changed); it is exercised through every protocol and broker test and left out of the coverage profile on purpose
# no-tests: internal/kmsg/internal/kbin: kmsg's binary reader and writer, vendored with it; the same
